'''Polythin''' was a lightweight material. [[Vector Technologies]] [[Plasteel/Legends|plasteel]] was strong enough to withstand a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] but was as light as polythin.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
